sections: Fix sideways and upside-down pages for good

Scanners, phones and fax machines regularly produce PDFs with pages turned the wrong way: a landscape table lying on its side, a receipt upside down, every second page of a duplex scan rotated. Turning the page in your PDF viewer only changes the view on your screen – the next person who opens the file sees it sideways again. {brand} writes the new orientation into the PDF itself, so the file opens the right way up everywhere: in Acrobat, Chrome, Preview, on phones and when printed.

It runs entirely in your browser. The PDF is opened on your device, the page rotation is updated and the result is downloaded – nothing is uploaded, which matters for contracts, ID scans and medical letters.
Rotate exactly the pages you need
**All pages** – the classic fix for a whole document scanned the wrong way.
**Odd or even pages** – correct duplex scans where only the back sides are upside down.
**Landscape pages only / portrait pages only** – straighten mixed documents where only the wide tables or drawings are sideways.
**A page range** – type 2, 5-7 to turn just those pages.
**90° clockwise, 180° or 90° counter-clockwise** in one click.
**Batch** – drop several PDFs and get them all back rotated in one ZIP.
Lossless rotation

Rotation in a PDF is a property of each page. Changing it does not re-render or re-compress anything, so text stays selectable and searchable, links and form fields keep working, and images keep their full quality. The file size barely changes. This is different from tools that convert pages to images and back, which can blur text and bloat the file.
How to rotate a PDF
Drop one or more PDFs onto the page.
Choose the angle: 90° clockwise, 180° or 270° (90° counter-clockwise).
Choose which pages: all, odd, even, landscape, portrait or a range.
Click Rotate and download. The result tells you how many pages were turned.
Rotating on Mac, Windows and phones

On a Mac, Preview can rotate pages and save the change; on Windows, the free PDF readers generally only rotate the view. This tool works the same on every system, including Chromebooks, Android phones and iPhones, without installing anything. For individual pages that need different angles, use [Organize PDF](/organize-pdf/), where every thumbnail has its own rotate button.
Common uses
Straightening scanned contracts before e-mailing them.
Fixing landscape spreadsheets printed into a portrait report.
Correcting phone photos of documents converted with [JPG to PDF](/jpg-to-pdf/).
Preparing files for printing or for [Merge PDF](/merge-pdf/), so every page faces the same way.
Making scanned books readable on tablets.
Tips
If a page looks right in one viewer but wrong in another, the PDF may have an unusual rotation flag – rotating 360° (90° four times) normalises it.
Scanned pages that are slightly crooked (a few degrees) need straightening, not rotation – try [Deskew PDF](/deskew-pdf/).
Password-protected PDF? Open it with [Unlock PDF](/unlock-pdf/) first if you know the password.

faq.q: Will the rotation be saved permanently?
faq.a: Yes. The new orientation is written into the PDF, so it opens the right way in every viewer and when printed.

faq.q: Can I rotate just one page?
faq.a: Yes. Choose 'Page range…' and enter the page number, or use Organize PDF to rotate individual thumbnails.

faq.q: Can I rotate only landscape pages?
faq.a: Yes. Choose 'Landscape pages only' to turn just the wide pages and leave the others untouched.
No. Only the page's rotation setting changes; text, images and links are untouched.

faq.q: Can I rotate several PDFs at once?
faq.a: Yes. Drop multiple files and download them together as a ZIP.
No. Rotation happens in your browser and works offline after the page loads.

faq.q: How do I rotate a PDF on Mac or Windows?
faq.a: Use this page in any browser – it works the same on Mac, Windows, Linux, Chromebook, Android and iPhone.

faq.q: Is there a file size limit?
faq.a: No fixed limit; very large files depend only on your device's memory.

faqKw.q: How do I rotate a PDF and save it that way?
faqKw.a: Choose the angle and which pages to turn (all, odd, even, landscape-only or a range), then download. The rotation is written into the file, so it opens the right way in every viewer – unlike the temporary rotate button in many PDF readers.
